judgment.summary: The representative conversation path is satisfactory: attachment disclosure, reading-position preservation, return to latest, Stop focus, failure/retry and seeded reload worked. Compact input and horizontal attachment browsing retain explicit spatial tradeoffs.
judgment.scope: Initial blind product judgment, not final release acceptance or comprehensive accessibility certification.

findings.observation: The original light desktop, dark compact and narrow populated captures retain the supplied mature sidebar, centered reading column, type, surfaces and anchored composer. The File and Button components, synthetic adapter, dependency lock, license and font CSS matched the foundation.

Keyboard filename disclosure exposed the complete name and local filename-only explanation. Escape restored the exact trigger; removing a file restored composer focus. The last narrow attachment was reached at strip scrollLeft 710 in a 1048 px strip with 338 px visible width; the dialog fit inside the 390 px viewport.

Manual wheel scrollTop stayed at 91 while content height grew from 1391 to 1727 px. Return-to-latest bottom gaps were 0 at all three samples across approximately 1.5 seconds while streaming continued.

Keyboard Stop returned focus to the composer by the 100 ms observation, the runtime became non-running, and recorded body text length remained 3623 across subsequent samples. A follow-up question could be sent and stopped.

The partial synthetic response failure remained visible in a clear error surface. Keyboard retry completed the fixed long response through Observation theme 7; reload returned to the seed as required by the in-memory boundary. No page errors were recorded.

At compact height the input is capped at 6rem. The independently viewed six-line question showed its last four lines, with earlier lines above the current visible portion. This preserves reading room but introduces internal input scrolling; the full question value was retained and sent.

Several attachments lie outside the current horizontal strip view. Modal filename disclosure temporarily blurs the conversation. Return to latest remains an icon with a localized tooltip/accessibility name.

Original captures show persistent native scrollbars, whereas the fresh compact capture does not show the same scrollbar chrome. No new scrollbar styling system was found in the source diff; this visual difference is not attributed to product redesign.

Full assistive-technology, physical touch, arbitrary attachment counts, extreme filename/draft lengths, all message-edit/branch actions, reduced-motion playback, upstream provenance authentication and cross-browser behavior were not established. The reduced-motion CSS was inspected but not separately behavior-tested.

review_conditions.isolation: Instructional isolation on a shared host; source choices and visible differences cannot be hidden.
review_conditions.stateful_tests: Delivered dist build in a disposable copy; frozen product and original captures unchanged.
review_conditions.review_type: Independent agent product judgment; not a human usability or assistive-technology study.
review_conditions.image_view_operation: One view_image per tool call, each actual return immediately retained and displayed.
review_conditions.source_view_reuse: The earlier personally viewed common T2 source capture is explicitly reused with its original export and timestamp.
